paragraphs.text: Split-pane file browser for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) right sidebar: directory tree + file preview

# dsh-2sidebar
English | 中文
A split-pane file browser for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) right sidebar: **the directory tree and the
selected file side by side in one tab** — both visible at once, so switching files never moves the
tree. The tree starts on the left and can be switched to the right.
> Status: early (`0.1.4`). The plugin uses DSH's client extension points, which are still moving — c
heck Compatibility before upgrading DSH.
## Why
DSH's built-in **Files** tab opens a file as a sidebar preview, so browsing and reading share one co
lumn. This plugin keeps the tree and the preview side by side in the same tab: click a file, the pre
view switches, the tree stays exactly where it was.
|                      | dsh-2sidebar                  | Built-in Files tab
| dsh-2sidebar                  | Built-in Files tab                                 |
| Layout               | tree and preview side by side | tree; a file opens as a preview in the same

column |
| Browse while reading | both always visible           | switch between tree and preview

|
| Text / image preview | inline, paged                 | native preview, all sup

ported formats              |
| Tree state           | kept while the tab is mounted | kept in the s

idebar store                          |
| Open shortcut        | header button / guide card    | `Mo
d+P`                                          |
Both can be installed and used at the same time.
## Features
- **Split view** with a draggable divider (20%–70%); the ratio and the collapsed-tree state are reme

mbered in this browser's localStorage (windows at the same origin share them).
- **Lazy directory tr
ee** rooted at the session's workspace: directories load when expanded, `Reload` refreshes the root
and expanded levels, and empty and truncated states are reported inline (a refresh that fails after

a successful load keeps the last listing).
- **Text preview** paged at 2,000 lines with `Load more`

/ `End of file`, plus a byte counter.
- **Image preview** for `png`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `gif`, `webp`, `

bmp`, `ico`, `avif` and `svg`.
- **Collapse the tree** to a single preview column, and restore it wi

thout losing the selected file.
- **Two entry points**: the split icon in the session header (next t
o the native sidebar toggle), and the guide card on the right sidebar start page; once opened it is

an ordinary right-sidebar tab.
- **Theme-aware styles**, English and Chinese UI.
- **Read-only and o
ffline**: no network calls, no host-side business code, and no npm runtime dependencies; rendering u
ses DSH's shell baseline client primitives (see Compatibility). File access goes through the host's
`workspaceFiles` service, under the same caps as the built-in features.
## Install
### Requirements

- DSH Desktop with a managed profile (tested on `0.2.1-rc.5`; see Compatibility).
- The right sideba
r and the client plugin manager (both ship with DSH).
### From npm (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or in the DSH Web GUI: **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → enter `dsh-2sidebar` → **Install**, then switc
h the **Split files** bundle on.
`desktop` is the default DSH Desktop profile; replace it if your installation uses another name. No
restart is needed: the host reloads the profile in place (HMR). If a tab that is already mounted kee
ps the old component, press `Ctrl+Shift+R`.
### From a clone (development)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You can also point the GUI's **Add plugin** dialog at the absolute path of the repository root.
### Open it
- Click the **split icon** in the session header, next to the native "open/collapse right sidebar" b

utton.
- Or open the right sidebar start page and pick the **Split files** card.
- The plugin is a n
ormal sidebar tab: dock, split and fullscreen behave exactly like other tabs.
### Uninstall

- GUI: **Plugins** → the **Split files** bundle → **Remove**.
- CLI:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Usage

- Click a directory to expand or collapse it; expanding re-reads that directory.
- Click a file to l

oad it into the preview pane; the tree keeps its scroll position and expansion state.
- Drag the div

ider to change the split ratio; the ratio is saved when you release.
- **Reload** refreshes the root

and every expanded directory.
- **Hide tree** collapses the tree pane; the preview keeps the select

ed directory.
- **Hide tree** collapses the tree pane; the preview keeps the selected file.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
- **Tested**: DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` on Windows (the client APIs used here were re-checked against

`0.2.1-rc.5`; `0.2.1-rc.3` was the previously tested version).
- **Expected to work**: other DSH De
sktop versions with the same client services (`slots`, `sessions`, `locale`, `sidebarRightTabs`, `si
debarRight`, `remote`, `remote.workspaceFiles`) and the shell's baseline client primitives (`@deepse
ek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`), and the macOS/Linux builds; the bundle itself is platform-independ

ent.
- DSH is in developer preview and its extension APIs can change without notice. If the plugin s
tops loading after a DSH upgrade, open an issue with the DSH version and the browser console error.
## How it works
The package is a **client-only bundle**:

- `index.js` is an empty host half; all rendering lives in the browser.
- The client registers a sid
ebar tab **type** (`ctx.sidebarRightTabs`), its **body** through the `sidebar.right.pane.tab` slot,
its **title** through `sidebar.right.pane.tab.title`, a header button through `conversation.session.

header.utilities`, and its own locale dictionaries (`zh`, `en`).
- Directory listings and file pages
come from the host's existing `ctx.remote.workspaceFiles` (`list` / `read` / `readBytes`); the work
space root comes from the framework's standard `useSessions` prop. The plugin adds no host routes an

d no permissions of its own.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one profile row; `keepMounted: true` keeps
the body alive across tab switches, so the tree state survives.
